world.topic: Measure how insertion sort and merge sort scale with input size in pure Python. Time each algorithm on random integer lists of sizes 250, 500, 1000, 2000 and 4000, five repetitions each, and fit the exponent of time against size on a log-log scale for each algorithm. The timing run takes a few minutes, so run it as a background job on the local-compute resource (ht-resource run) rather than inside your turn, and continue when it ends. Deliver the script, the raw timings as CSV, one log-log figure and a one-page report with the two fitted exponents.
